claim_scope: Consumed-development trajectory diagnosis only; no held-out, leaderboard, or treatment-effect claim.

cohort.excluded_pair: flash0731-dev16-case-05 because both arms were provider-censored
cohort.sampling_limitation: Historical schedule seeds were not forwarded to model requests, so arm differences are descriptive realizations rather than deterministic counterfactual pairs.

measurement.boundary: The first observed zero-missing-import state, clean-replay pass, or accepted submission; otherwise the complete failed episode.
measurement.global_probe: An executed Pyright reportMissingImports probe with an explicit count, diagnostic listing, or empty filtered summary.
measurement.local_probe: Runtime, test, import, or other command that does not establish the complete public compatibility objective.

diagnostic_examples.interpretation: The agent reached a near-feasible state, later regressed, and did not recover the best observed compatibility state before termination.

diagnostic_examples.interpretation: A temporary compatibility regression can lie on a successful path, so a hard monotonic-state rule would be unsound.

diagnostic_examples.trajectory: zero missing imports in the mutable construction environment, followed later by a clean-replay counterexample
diagnostic_examples.outcome: repaired candidate eventually passed clean replay and Official evaluation
diagnostic_examples.interpretation: Compatibility observation and state-to-program certification solve different failure stages and should remain separate.

diagnostic_examples.outcome: candidate formed and the Official evaluator passed
diagnostic_examples.interpretation: Repeated unchanged global states expose a useful stopping or strategy-switch signal without implying which package operation to choose.

rejected_as_primary_gap: literal command forgetting or exact-command repetition
a need to forbid all compatibility regressions
a need for package-specific operation mappings
retained_support_components: certified incumbent as an orthogonal safety ablation
hypothesis_decisions.next_hypothesis: During the continuous active session, a machine-maintained compatibility-delta ledger can make sparse global evidence persistent without constraining the strong agent's operation space.

minimal_treatment.name: active-session-compatibility-delta-ledger
minimal_treatment.observation_layer: An explicit tool executes the trusted public goal in the current construction environment and returns the complete unresolved-import set plus a compact interpreter/environment fingerprint.
minimal_treatment.constraint_layer: The harness records resolved and introduced obligations and retains nondominated observed obligation sets. The ledger is monotonic in accumulated evidence, not in permitted environment states.
minimal_treatment.operation_layer: The same model session keeps unrestricted shell control. The ledger supplies no package mapping, command ranking, blocking rule, rollback, or container checkpoint.
minimal_treatment.candidate_boundary: When the observed unresolved set is empty, compile a complete bootstrap program and use the existing clean-replay interface.
minimal_treatment.difference_from_archived_frontiers: The treatment changes only in-session feedback. It does not restart independent model sessions, generate whole-program candidates per round, impose a finite candidate frontier, or add cross-candidate semantic rules.

supported: Global compatibility feedback was sparse relative to local operations in these trajectories.
More than one third of comparable global transitions were stagnant or regressing.
Exact command repetition was rare and does not explain the observed search cost.
Both harmful drift and useful temporary regression occurred, motivating informative rather than hard monotonicity.
not_supported: A compatibility ledger improves Official Pass, time, tokens, or memory.
Every local operation should trigger an automatic global goal execution.
Fewer missing imports always identifies a higher-quality deployment path.
The historical arm trajectories estimate a causal treatment effect.
The proposed treatment generalizes beyond consumed development cases.

next_decision: Implement the ledger as one optional in-session tool, qualify its invariants offline, then preregister a counterbalanced repeated pilot on consumed cases before touching any remaining Dev case.
